templates.system: You are a creative writing character designer. Respond strictly in KEY: VALUE format.
templates.existingLine: Existing characters (never reuse any of these names): {characters}
templates.contrastLine: Make this character clearly different from the existing ones: contrasting traits, motivation and flaw, so they pull against each other.
templates.nameInstruction: Invent a distinctive, concrete name appropriate for this story premise and role. Never output placeholders like [Character Name] or [companion name].
templates.nameConstraint: Name inspiration (a loose hint, not a rule; the story's genre and tone win if they clash): {origin}-inspired, the first name starts with the letter {letter}.
templates.formatHeading: Respond ONLY with the following lines (no preamble, no markdown asterisks):
templates.hint.NAME: {NAME}: An evocative character name
templates.hint.FLAW: {FLAW}: Significant internal conflict or fatal flaw
templates.completeInstruction: Some details of this character are missing. Decide only the missing ones so they fit the story and the details already chosen. Never output placeholders like [Character Name].
